SOLID principles in Playwright frameworks

diagram.title: SOLID principles in Playwright frameworks — step by step

steps.label: 12.1 Single Responsibility Principle (SRP)
steps.narration: A class should have a focused responsibility.

steps.label: 12.2 Open/Closed Principle (OCP)
steps.narration: Design the framework so additional behavior can be introduced through appropriate extension rather than repeatedly editing stable core logic.

steps.label: 12.3 Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP)
steps.narration: If implementations follow the same contract, substituting one implementation should preserve the expected behavior of its consumer.

steps.label: 12.4 Interface Segregation Principle (ISP)
steps.narration: Avoid forcing classes to implement unrelated operations.

steps.label: 12.5 Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP)
steps.narration: High-level test workflows should depend on appropriate abstractions rather than hardcoded infrastructure.
